prompts.editorial:
You are an expert science journalist writing for Dataist — an AI/ML media outlet. Write an engaging, accessible review article in Russian based on the provided arXiv paper.

Requirements:
- Write in a lively editorial style, not academic
- Explain complex concepts clearly for a technical but non-specialist audience
- Use the glossary for consistent terminology
- Structure the article with clear sections (use ## for headings)
- Include a compelling introduction that hooks the reader
- Explain why this research matters
- Highlight key findings and methodology
- Add a concluding section with implications
- Do NOT copy the abstract verbatim
- Article length: 1500-3000 words
- Include references to figures where relevant, using their captions

Glossary:
{glossary}

Paper abstract:
{abstract}

Paper full text:
{article_text}

Figures and captions:
{figures_info}

Write the review article in Russian:
prompts.title:
Generate a catchy, informative title for this AI/ML article review. The title should:
- Be in Russian
- Be attention-grabbing but not clickbait
- Reflect the core innovation or finding
- Be under 100 characters
- NOT use quotes or colons

Article summary:
{short_intro}

Return ONLY the title text, nothing else.
prompts.cover:
Create an artistic, cinematic cover image for a scientific article about: {article_summary}

Style requirements:
- Color palette: {palette}
- Mood: {mood}
- Composition: centered, clean, minimalist with depth
- NO text, NO letters, NO words, NO watermarks
- NO human faces or realistic humans
- Abstract technological/scientific visualization
- Cinematic lighting with dramatic shadows
- High quality, 16:9 aspect ratio
- Futuristic, elegant, premium feel

prompts.teaser:
Write a short teaser (2-3 sentences) in {language} for a Telegram post about this article. The teaser should:
- Hook the reader immediately
- Mention the key innovation
- Make them want to read the full article
- Use emoji sparingly (1-2 max)
- End with a call to read more

Article title: {title}
Article intro: {short_intro}

Return ONLY the teaser text.
prompts.translation:
Translate the following Russian article into English. Preserve:
- All formatting and structure
- Technical terms accuracy
- Section headings
- Figure references
- The editorial tone (engaging, accessible)

Do NOT translate brand names, model names, or acronyms that are commonly used in English.

Russian article:
{article_body}

English translation:
prompts.link_extraction:
Extract all relevant links from this paper text. Look for:
- GitHub repository URLs
- HuggingFace model/dataset URLs
- Project website URLs
- Demo URLs

Paper text:
{article_text}

Return a JSON object with keys: github_url, huggingface_url, project_url, demo_url. Use empty string for missing links.
Return ONLY valid JSON.
